newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Germans ask for Commisson inspection results.
newsitem.headline: Germans ask for Commisson inspection results.

text.p: The European Commission told EU farm ministers on Monday that it would publish in March the findings of its investigations into mad cow disease controls.

Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler told the ministers that the findings of the Commission's BSE (bovine spongiform encephalopathy) inspection teams would be given to member state governments, an EU official said.
He said bilateral discussions would then take place before the reports were sent to the EU standing permanent veterinary committee, which would make recommendations.
Germany protested that a report by Commission inspectors criticising itsr BSE controls was announced by the press, the official said.
"The German delegation were unhappy at the way the German press announced the findings of an inspection team which studied BSE risk factors," the official added.
